summary.en: Kimi K3 support for context-heavy research and long-document work.
summary.zh: 面向上下文密集研究与长文档任务的 Kimi K3 支持。

title.en: Kimi K3 belongs where the source material is the task.
title.zh: 当资料本身就是任务时，Kimi K3 才真正发挥价值。

description.en: Floatboat's broader support matrix includes Kimi K3 for research collections, long documents, and context-heavy synthesis. This is platform support, not a claim of current client-picker availability.
description.zh: Floatboat 的更广泛支持矩阵包含 Kimi K3，用于研究资料、长文档与上下文密集型综合分析；这是平台支持，并不表示当前已进入客户端选择器。

title.en: Kimi K3 in the platform matrix.
title.zh: 平台矩阵中的 Kimi K3。

description.en: Its page exists to describe the supported long-context role—not to imply a picker entry that is not listed.
description.zh: 本页用于说明其长上下文定位，不暗示清单中没有的客户端入口。
研究综合与长文档理解。

question.en: Can I select Kimi K3 in the current client picker?
question.zh: 当前客户端可以直接选择 Kimi K3 吗？

answer.en: It is listed in the platform and ecosystem matrix, not in the current client-picker list supplied for this page.
answer.zh: 它属于平台与生态矩阵，不在本页依据的当前客户端选择器清单中。

question.en: What work is Kimi K3 positioned for?
question.zh: Kimi K3 的定位是什么？

answer.en: Context-heavy research and long-document work where relationships across many sources matter.
answer.zh: 面向需要跨大量资料建立关系的上下文密集研究与长文档任务。

title.en: Keep Kimi K3 on the long-context map.
title.zh: 把 Kimi K3 纳入长上下文能力地图。

description.en: Follow its platform rollout when research collections and long documents define the workload.
description.zh: 当研究资料和长文档构成主要工作量时，关注其平台接入进展。
